policy_inputs: MOVE calibration decision plus adaptive D5 spare schedule
invariants: ACCEPT is reachable only from RUN_2PV on a fresh attempt
REPAIRING can never transition directly to ACCEPT or RETRY_READY
successful repair must traverse RECEIPT_K4 then RECEIPT_S4 before RETRY_READY
RETRY_READY must transition to a fresh RUN_2PV before ACCEPT can occur
two or more detected active-channel losses force HOLD
missing required MOVE/site calibration leaves SOURCE_BLOCKED
DEGRADED_NO_SPARE may complete a current clean attempt but future detected channel loss cannot be repaired until a spare is restored
latent_analytic_state: UNSAFE_ACCEPT_POSSIBLE is not observable to the controller; it represents missed-loss paths in analysis only.
claim_rule: passing model checks establishes implementation correctness of the frozen abstract controller, not fault tolerance or hardware performance.
